chat_messages.content: How can I prepare for a software developer interview?

**Mock Interview Preparation Strategy:**

1. **Master the Fundamentals:** Deeply understand time complexities, OOP design principles, and REST API conventions.
2. **The STAR Framework:** Structure behavioral answers around **S**ituation, **T**ask, **A**ction, and **R**esult.
3. **Practice Out Loud:** Use our **Mock Interview** module with speech-to-text to test your answers against real technical criteria!

questions.text: Explain the difference between process and thread, and how memory is shared.
What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced BST vs an unsorted array?
How do RESTful APIs handle idempotency, and which HTTP methods are idempotent?

mock_interview_sessions.overall_feedback: Demonstrated strong foundational knowledge of operating systems and database design.

questions.text: Explain the difference between process and thread, and how memory is shared between them.
questions.criteria: Memory space separation, thread stack vs heap, context switching overhead.

questions.text: What is the time and space complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree vs an unsorted array?
questions.criteria: O(log N) vs O(N) time complexity, tree balancing rationale.

questions.text: How do RESTful APIs handle idempotency, and which HTTP methods are idempotent?
questions.criteria: GET, PUT, DELETE are idempotent; POST is not. Explanation of duplicate requests.

questions.text: Explain the ACID properties of relational databases with a real banking transfer example.
questions.criteria: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability with rollback scenario.

questions.text: How does garbage collection work in languages like Java or Node.js?
questions.criteria: Mark and sweep, reference counts, generation phases, memory leak prevention.
